name: Parry Peak Campground
evidence: Esri z18/z19 39.0655,-106.4100: Hwy 82 is on the creek's far side, not between (prior evidence wrong). West-bank spur pullouts with RVs measure 45-60 m from ~10-15 m Lake Creek through spruce; closest road bend ~23 m, no pad there. No per-site map, tags or site photos (rec.gov 10165525 scan-pay).

name: Peaceful Valley Campground
evidence: Esri z19 + rec.gov 232368 site plot: RV site 7 (45 ft, reservable) ~20 m from Middle St. Vrain across open grass, sites 1/2 ~20-23 m with scattered brush; no gully screen at 7. Creek well under 30 m. Sites 10-14 walk-to don't count. No per-site photos; facility gallery shows open meadow.

name: River Hill Campground
evidence: Esri z19 + rec.gov 233811 sites: Rio Grande channel measures ~20-25 m at the sites, under the ~30 m line. Sites 9/10/12/14 (25 ft+) ~15 m from bank over open ground behind a narrow willow fringe; site 12 photo shows water through trees. All 18 RV site photos viewed.

name: Salida East Campground
evidence: Esri z19 with cpwshop site coords: Arkansas ~40-55 m wide. NE-edge pads, near tagged 1603/1604/1606/1607/1609 (31-43 ft; coords sit off the pads), ~15-25 m from bank behind a narrow broken tree strip; 1606 and 1603 photos show river through trees. Tagged 1626-1633 lack coords/lengths, not counted. 23 photos of 9 tagged sites viewed.

name: Rock Creek Campground
evidence: Esri z19 three frames (near leaf-off, east side in canyon shadow): creek ~5 m; roads run ~10-25 m from it through open aspen south of 37.4685, toilet clearing ~55 m. Pads not resolved; rec.gov 10405347 has no coords or photos. FS 'some sites next to the creek' is prose; on-water not proven, held at riverview.

name: Rivers End Campground
evidence: Esri z18/z16, USGS topo, Open-Meteo DEM (loops 2845 m, full pool ~2844): open sagebrush loops ~30-80 m from full-pool edge, willow belt between; Taylor River channel ~14 m wide ~35-50 m off behind the same willows. No per-site data (rec.gov 10165576 scan-pay), so no on-water upgrade; open ground keeps the view.

name: Silver Bell
evidence: Esri z19 + rec.gov 231882 plot: only site 7 (30 ft) counts, ~40 m from Maroon Creek through spruce; site 1 capped 22 ft and farther; remaining sites tent/walk-to don't count. 'On the banks' is prose. rec.gov and FS carry no site photos, so no filtered view found.

name: South Fork White River Campground
evidence: rec.gov 10362454 tags all 18 sites Riverfront (no coords/photos), a blanket tag. Esri z19 39.8657,-107.5348: open grass with a worn path from a southern west-side spur to a ~10-14 m channel, ~25-30 m; could be fishing access, pads not resolved; northern spurs ~40 m through trees. Creek by size; on-water not proven, held at riverview.
